title: Barack Obama on Gay Marriage
summary: A two-minute clip from 2008 in which Barack Obama states his position on same-sex marriage and civil unions. He says he supports civil unions rather than promoting same-sex marriage.
why: HN cites it as a record of Obama's 2008 stance, usually to make a point about how mainstream views on gay marriage shifted.

quote.text: I'm not somebody who promotes same-sex marriage, but I do believe in civil unions.
